what: `#[rustc_clean(..)]` is refused with rustc's own text (`attribute requires -Z query-dep-graph to be enabled`) and `-Z query-dep-graph` in rustflags is refused too (`blaze does not know which cfgs -Z query-dep-graph decides`), so 88 files of rustc's `tests/incremental` cannot build unchanged under blaze by any setting.
cost: an hour: the importer had to write the attributes over with spaces
cause: blaze ports the gate of an attribute whose flag it has no meaning for
workaround: the importer blanks the six assertion attributes, columns kept
state: open: accept the attributes as inert (they assert on rustc's queries), or accept the flag
